entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Sequence query (210 aa) matches reviewed dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases; best hit Q67SL4 has 49.5% identity, 91.9% query coverage, and E-value 1.15e-46.
Homolog annotations assign EC 3.6.1.66 and hydrolysis of XTP, dITP, and ITP to corresponding monophosphate plus diphosphate; Mg2+ is annotated as a cofactor.
The proposed nucleotide-pool sanitizing role is inferred from homolog annotations; the exact activity of the query protein has not been experimentally established in this analysis.
